correctness.rationale: C PASS: For even positive C2 normal density on S2, coarea and independence give n-fold boundary intensity n*h_f(x)*(1-q_f(p,x))^(n-1). Uniform q_f(p,x(theta,alpha))=theta*a(alpha)+O(theta^2), and q_f>=min(f)*theta/pi, provide an integrable exponential envelope. With s=n*theta the annealed arclength law n*mu_n has TV limit h0*s*exp(-s*a(alpha)); integrates to R=h0*integral(a^-2). Fourier cosine kernel even modes are nonzero; (w,R) uniquely fixes a, h0 and continuous equatorial g; Jensen gives R>=pi^3/(2*h0), equality iff g constant. Check explicit quadrupolar f_eps gives R_eps=pi^3/(1-eps^2/9)^(3/2). No claim to f off-equator or quenched boundary samples.
